theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_sc_stationary_integration_by_parts
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ tsupport X → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ((∀ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → ∀ j : Fin P, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M)) ∧ ∀ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∃ (C' : Set (Euclid P)) (ζs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact C' ∧ C' ⊆ M ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (ζs k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ζs k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C' → ζs k x = 0) ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn ζs ζ atTop M ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j : Fin P, (fderiv ℝ (ζs k) x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2) ∂μHE[m]) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ (f F : Euclid P → ℝ) (O' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O' → M ⊆ O' → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 F O' → (∀ y ∈ M, F y = f y) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, LocallyLipschitzOn M φ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → φ x = 0) → Integrable (fun x => ∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ φ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) * fderivWithin ℝ f M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M) ∧ Integrable (fun x => φ x * ∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ f M y ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M) ∧ ∫ x in M, (∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ φ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) * fderivWithin ℝ f M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ∂μHE[m] = -(∫ x in M, φ x * (∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ f M y ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ∂μHE[m])
